description: State variable filter giving low-pass, band-pass and high-pass from one input at once

params.text: Sets the centre frequency, 8Hz at one end and 8000Hz at the other
Sets the resonance, gentle at one end and sharp enough to ring at the other
Attenuverts the FREQ input before it moves the frequency, -1 to +1, and with the knob hard over the input tracks a volt per octave

inputs.text: Moves the centre frequency, scaled by the F.MOD knob and with no effect while that knob is centred
Adds to the resonance, 5V taking it from nothing to full

outputs.text: The low-pass output, which passes what is below the centre frequency
The band-pass output, which passes what is around the centre frequency
The high-pass output, which passes what is above the centre frequency
